fact: Enabel's final evaluation (June 2024) states that the PAOP project, run with the Republican Police in Cotonou, Tchaourou and Parakou, supplied computer and office equipment and an internet connection to renovated police stations, and that police human resources management is being digitalised.
title: Executive Summary Evaluation Report on the Projects for Supporting the Operationalization of the Police in Benin and Crisis Management PAOP/PAOP CRI
